notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo will be taking part of China’s WePlay Expo 2023
notes.content:
WePlay Expo 2023, organized by CiGA, stands as the preeminent gaming culture festival in China, captivating audiences since its inception in 2017. This extraordinary gaming extravaganza showcases a diverse array of high-quality indie games, 3A games, and global cultural content, making it a must-attend event for gaming enthusiasts.

Over the past few years, WePlay has grown into a dynamic platform, featuring more than 300 games from 10 countries, offering on-site free trials annually. The upcoming WePlay 2023 is scheduled to take place on the [b]18th and 19th of November[/b] at Hall H4 of the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, China. The event promises an expansion and enhancement of content and experiences, transforming it into a comprehensive gaming festival that spans consoles, PC, mobile, immersion experiences, board games, speaker sessions, anime, fashion, merchandise, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/43e1b851d7252b58ee6c48c415f9b9e653b0bffb.png[/img]

The event offers not only a showcase but also conferences and B2B sessions, making it the ideal platform to explore cooperation opportunities and promote games effectively in the thriving Chinese market."
In addition to the consumer-focused aspects, WePlay Expo 2023 will host conferences and B2B sessions, providing an invaluable opportunity for industry professionals to explore collaboration and business development.

As part of the excitement surrounding WePlay Expo 2023, the extraordinary "The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo," an incredible, unique, and bizarre "point n' click" adventure, will be available at a [b]15% discount[/b] on Steam. This celebratory offer aims to mark the game's presence at the expo and invites gamers to embark on a captivating journey at a special price.

[b]Bug Fixes and Enhancements[/b]:
A quick sum up about every single improvement and bug fix applied during these last months:

•	Small input blockings have been fixed.
•	Animations have been polished for a smoother visual experience.
•	General gameplay improvements have been implemented.
•	The hintbook feature has been enhanced for better guidance.
•	Collectables album functionality has been added.

notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo will be at Tokyo Game Show 2023
notes.content:
Attention Coolleagues!

We have important news for you: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo will be at Tokyo Game Show 2023.

The COVID-19 pandemic has caused many events to be affected and most of them had to be done online. Fortunately, this is coming to an end, and we already have one of the world's leading video game events back in a fully face-to-face manner. The Tokyo Game Show is back stronger than ever. 

The new edition of the popular Japanese fair is once again present this year 2023. It will take place from September 21 to 24 and will be held at the Makuhari Messe convention center in Japan.

The four-day Tokyo Game Show 2023 will be well packed with major events, including its presentation and the Japan Game Awards ceremony. 

Both September 21 and 22 will be devoted entirely to companies looking to close deals and showcase their games to publishers. On September 23 and 24, the doors will be open to all those who want to come to TGS to try out the games for themselves.

And of course, one of the games you can't miss is The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo. If you don't know this marvel yet and you have the chance, don't hesitate to try it out at Tokyo Game Show 2023. 

For those who can't attend, you will also be able to watch it through the official channels of the event.

Don't forget that The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is already available on PlayStation Store, Nintendo eShop and Microsoft Store.

notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr.Coo will be present at Gamescom
notes.content:
Very soon we will be immersed in Gamescom 2023, the largest face-to-face event of the video game industry in Europe that is held annually in Germany. Mr.Coo's pieces will be at the Indie Arena, in Hall 10, where gamers from all over the world will be able to try the demo of The Many Pieces of Mr.Coo and meet its creator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/578deba0e0d278f9df6780ab566404645b89900c.jpg[/img]

The Many Pieces of Mr.Coo is a completely surreal point'n'click adventure game. Mr. Coo is trapped in a strange, nonsensical world, and he needs your help to get through it. But first of all he needs to find all his pieces and put his body back together again! I'm sure there's some philosophical struggle behind all this nonsense, but between giant chickens, crazy robots and one-eyed ladies, it's a little hard to tell.

An amazing and colorful 2D cartoon. A surreal and whimsical story, full of absurd humor, quirky characters and crazy situations, plus innovative puzzles. Undoubtedly this is a new take on the adventure game genre that will appeal to both veteran players and newcomers alike.

Mr. Coo and this game are creations of acclaimed artist Nacho Rodriguez. 2D animator and director nominated for the Goya Awards for his short film "A lifestory". He was also animation director of the game O.zen at Ubisoft. Mr. Coo is his most famous character, having appeared in several hilarious short films.
 

Discover the physical editions of The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch here meridiem-games.com/new/nWnW8pxr8g7[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/578deba0e0d278f9df6780ab566404645b89900c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo will be exhibiting at BitSummit
notes.content:
The captivating point and click adventure game, The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo, created by the talented cartoonist and animator Nacho Rodriguez, will be shown at the Japanese event BitSummit on 14, 15 and 16 July at the Miyako Messe convention centre in Kyoto.

Established in late-2012, BitSummit was founded with the goal of giving Japanese independent game makers a chance to show their games to the world, and we succeeded, growing from a small, industry-only event for around 200 people in 2013, to a groundbreaking festival that held court to over 11,000 people in 2018. Bolstered by keynotes from industry veterans like Shuhei Yoshida (Sony Interactive Entertainment), Suehiro Tanaka (White Owls), Atsushi Inaba & Hideki Kamia (Platinum Games), and Tetsuya Mizuguchi (Enhance Games).

As well as support from leading industry companies like Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft, and Valve, BitSummit has established itself as a leading venue in which indie developers can showcase their talents for the world to see. The event can also be followed on BitSummit's Youtube, Tik Tok and Twitch channels in Japanese, English and Chinese.

 If you don't know yet this marvel called The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo, don't hesitate to try it at BitSummit if you are in Kyoto. You can also try it on Steam and soon on PlayStation Store and Nintendo eShop if you are not in Japan.

The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo immerses you in a fascinating game that combines traditional animation and stop motion, thanks to Nacho Rodriguez's drawing skills - a true vindication of video game art, classic animation and comedy fun!

The plot is full of mesmerising events that will leave you with your eyes wide open, all accompanied by a hypnotic soundtrack.

In The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo, you accompany the charismatic Mr. Coo through a surreal, disturbing and colourful world to solve the puzzles surrounding him and help him rebuild his body. The character interacts in a variety of ways, adapting to the environment, objects and situations in unexpected ways.

Very soon you will be able to get your hands on this amazing game, if your wrists don't fall off first! Don't miss its release on 7 September, in both physical and digital formats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/4ca0d55658a93de953d71f5549660e000a9a6541.png[/img]
